question_en: A fire-alarm component fails a periodic inspection. What replacement approach matches the RSOS?
options: Select an OEM or equivalent component meeting manufacturer/facility/code requirements, replace it, then test and verify it.
Install any physically similar component without testing.
Disable the affected zone permanently.
Ignore the failure until the next inspection.
explanation_en: E-26.02 requires appropriate OEM/equivalent replacement components and testing/verification according to codes, standards and regulations.
explanation_es: E-26.02 exige reemplazo OEM/equivalente apropiado y pruebas/verificación según códigos, normas y reglamentos.

question_en: A fire-alarm maintenance test result has drifted from commissioning data but the system has not annunciated a fault. What should the electrician do?
options: Evaluate the test result against previous data, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation rather than relying only on the absence of an alarm.
Ignore the drift because no fault is displayed.
Change detector locations without documentation.
Increase circuit voltage.
explanation_en: E-26.02 requires evaluation of test results against previous/manufacturer/commissioning references.
explanation_es: E-26.02 exige evaluar los resultados frente a referencias previas, del fabricante y commissioning.

question_en: When maintaining a communication system, what should be done after obtaining the malfunction description?
options: Test the system using appropriate diagnostic/test equipment and evaluate results using previous, manufacturer and commissioning information.
Replace all cabling immediately.
Use only visual inspection regardless of system type.
Ignore documentation.
explanation_en: E-27.02 requires testing using diagnostic/test equipment and evaluation against previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: E-27.02 exige probar con equipo de diagnóstico y evaluar contra resultados previos, fabricante y commissioning.

question_en: An optical communication link fails after a component replacement. What should be included before the work is considered complete?
options: Test and verify the replacement, update detailed documentation, and notify/explain system changes to facility personnel.
Only close the enclosure.
Delete the old commissioning records.
Change unrelated network equipment.
explanation_en: E-27.02 requires replacement components to be tested/verified, documentation updated, and system changes communicated to facility representatives.
explanation_es: E-27.02 exige probar/verificar el reemplazo, actualizar documentación y comunicar cambios al personal de la instalación.

question_en: An analog transmitter calibration is within tolerance, but the process value still fluctuates. What RSOS-based check is appropriate?
options: Review and analyze signal trends and verify signal integrity/process operation.
Replace the PLC CPU immediately.
Ignore the trend because calibration passed.
Increase the transmitter range.
explanation_en: F-29.04 includes reviewing/analyzing input-signal trends to verify integrity and verifying operation according to process parameters.
explanation_es: F-29.04 incluye revisar/analizar tendencias de la señal y verificar operación según parámetros de proceso.

question_en: A serviced analog output drives a proportional valve to the wrong position. What should be checked before changing controller logic?
options: Verify the I/O device, signal/polarity, calibration and operation against process parameters.
Change PLC logic first without field verification.
Bypass the valve feedback permanently.
Ignore as-found/as-left data.
explanation_en: F-29 requires correct polarity/connection, calibration documentation and verification of device operation against process parameters.
explanation_es: F-29 exige polaridad/conexión correctas, documentación de calibración y verificación de operación según parámetros de proceso.

question_en: A maintenance trend shows gradual drift in an analog input. What is the most appropriate next action?
options: Analyze the trend, inspect/test the field device and calibrate/adjust as required while documenting as-found/as-left values.
Scale the display to hide the drift.
Replace all I/O modules.
Disable the alarm.
explanation_en: F-29.04 ties signal-trend analysis, field-device testing, calibration and as-found/as-left documentation together.
explanation_es: F-29.04 relaciona análisis de tendencias, pruebas del dispositivo, calibración y documentación as-found/as-left.

question_en: A PLC program change corrects the sequence but has not been backed up. What is still required by the RSOS?
options: Verify the program to specified logic, back up and document the changes, and test/adjust the system.
Nothing if the machine completes one cycle.
Delete the previous documentation.
Disable program-change records.
explanation_en: F-30.03 requires verification, backup/documentation and testing/adjustment of program changes.
explanation_es: F-30.03 exige verificación, respaldo/documentación y pruebas/ajustes de cambios de programa.

question_en: A new field device has been added to an automated-control system. Which programming workflow best matches the RSOS?
options: Map the I/O, set address variables, write/edit and verify logic, back up/document changes, then test and adjust.
Edit the program without identifying the I/O.
Change the network protocol without testing.
Leave the change undocumented.
explanation_en: F-30.03 identifies I/O mapping, addressing, program edit/verification, backup/documentation and test/adjust activities.
explanation_es: F-30.03 identifica mapeo de I/O, direccionamiento, edición/verificación, respaldo/documentación y pruebas/ajustes.

question_en: During hydraulic-control maintenance, which parameters are specifically used to verify system operation?
options: Pressure, flow, temperature and level as applicable to system specifications.
Only electrical frequency.
Only motor horsepower.
Only enclosure temperature.
explanation_en: F-31.04 lists pressure, flow, temperature and level among system specifications used for hydraulic control maintenance.
explanation_es: F-31.04 lista presión, flujo, temperatura y nivel entre las especificaciones usadas en mantenimiento hidráulico.

question_en: A hydraulic actuator response is slow and system pressure is abnormal. What maintenance approach matches the RSOS?
options: Test/verify control devices and components, check fluid/filters, identify probable root cause/location, calibrate or replace as required.
Increase controller output without checking the hydraulic system.
Replace the PLC first.
Ignore fluid and filters.
explanation_en: F-31.04 includes verification, calibration/adjustment, checking fluid/filters and identifying probable root cause/location of faults.
explanation_es: F-31.04 incluye verificación, calibración/ajuste, revisión de fluido/filtros e identificación de causa raíz/ubicación de fallas.
